Town Clerk
Mission Statement
The Town Clerk’s Office is a reliable provider of information and quality services to the community and its residents, and to work cooperatively and in concert with all departments, boards and committees while complying with state and local statutes.
Role of the Department
This office embraces its vital role as a hub where citizens gather information regarding local and state government. It also serves as:
Chief Election Official
Recording Officer of all official elections
Registrar of Vital Statistics
Public Records Officer
Licensing Office
